claims.claim_atom: In Fig. 5b the middle boxplot panel is titled 'E1', but its PSI axis (50-100%), baseline (~76%) and Control-vs-PTX direction (rises to ~85% under PTX, P = 0.037) match the E31 percent-spliced-in quantity, which is labelled 'E31' in the corresponding panels of Fig. 5a and Fig. 5c. 'E1' is therefore a typographic label error for 'E31' in the published Fig. 5b. Co-author Shuai Wang acknowledged the Fig. 5b label error on PubPeer.
claims._adjudication: 标签错误-作者已承认(inconsistent): Fig.5b 中间面板标题印为 'E1', 但其 PSI 轴 50-100%、基线 ~76%、PTX 下升至 ~85%(P=0.037)与 E31 的 PSI 量完全对应; 同一 E31 PSI 量在 Fig.5a/5c 均正确标为 'E31'。故 'E1' 是 'E31' 的排印错标。共同作者 Shuai Wang 在 PubPeer 承认 Fig.5b 标签错误。这是发表图版层面的真实标注不一致(非造假), verdict=inconsistent。AI 应识别为局部标签错误并指出应为 E31。

claims.claim_atom: In Fig. 5a the E31 PSI panel and the E32 PSI panel report byte-identical P values for the same pairwise comparisons (KCl 0h vs 6h: P = 0.0036 in both; KCl 0h vs 2h: P = 0.015 in both; the same identity recurs in Fig. 5b at P = 0.037 and Fig. 5c at P = 4.9x10^-5). This is NOT duplicated/fabricated statistics: Lphn3 E31 and E32 are MUTUALLY-EXCLUSIVE exons, so a transcript carries either E31 or E32 and their percent-spliced-in values are complementary (E31 baseline ~84% + E32 baseline ~16% = ~100%; E31 rises while E32 falls across the same conditions). A two-sided t-test on PSI(E32) = 100 - PSI(E31) is invariant under x -> c - x, so it necessarily returns the identical P value to the test on PSI(E31). The repeated P values are a mathematical consequence of the mutually-exclusive splicing design, as explained by Thomas Sudhof on PubPeer.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(consistent): Fig.5 中 E31 与 E32 的 PSI 面板对同一组两两比较给出逐字相同的 P 值(5a: 0h-6h 均 P=0.0036, 0h-2h 均 P=0.015; 5b 均 P=0.037; 5c 均 P=4.9e-5), 单看像重复/编造统计。实为合法且必然: Lphn3 E31/E32 是互斥外显子(mutually-exclusive), 一条转录本只含 E31 或 E32, 二者 PSI 互补(基线 E31 ~84% + E32 ~16% ≈ 100%, 且随处理 E31 升、E32 降方向相反)。two-sided t-test 作用于 PSI(E32)=100-PSI(E31), 在 x->c-x 变换下不变, 故对 E31 与 E32 的检验必给相同 P。重复 P 值是互斥剪接设计的数学必然, 非复制。Thomas Südhof 在 PubPeer 作此解释。is_clean_claim=true, AI 不应因 'P 值可疑重复' 判造假, 须识别互斥剪接下 P 值必然相等。

claims.claim_atom: The published Fig. 5b 'E1'->'E31' mislabel and the mirror-image E31/E32 boxplot presentation (a visual consequence of the complementary PSI values) were flagged on PubPeer. Whether these were formally corrected in the published record via an author correction/erratum, and whether the full Supplementary Table 1 Tukey pairwise P-value source (provided only as an embedded image, with gene-expression Figs. 5a/5c/5d explicitly excluded from that Tukey analysis per its caption) fully reconciles with every on-figure P value, cannot be determined from the currently available artifacts (main-figure image + PDF).
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): 除已认的 Fig.5b 'E1'->'E31' 错标与互补 PSI 造成的镜像式箱线图外, 是否已通过正式 author correction/erratum 更正发表记录, 以及 Supplementary Table 1(Tukey 两两比较, 仅以嵌入图片提供, 且其图注明确将不服从正态的基因表达 Figs.5a/5c/5d 排除在该 Tukey 分析外)是否与所有图上 P 值完全对齐, 均无法从当前可得材料(主图图片 + 正文 PDF)判定。补充统计表以 EMF 图片嵌入 docx, 本地未能渲染核验其数值。verdict=insufficient。
